deployments_detail.use: ReSound Vivia AI-powered hearing aid with "Intelligent Focus" deep neural network for noise handling

ReSound Vivia prescription hearing aid with a dedicated Deep Neural Network (DNN) chip trained on 13.5 million spoken sentences (equivalent to ~25 years of conversation) to spotlight speech and suppress noise in real time; marketed as the world's smallest AI-powered hearing aid. [GN in-house DNN / dedicated DNN chip]
deployments_detail.value: DNN chip up to 17x more powerful; trained on 13.5 million spoken sentences

deployments_detail.use: Jabra PanaCast 50 intelligent video bar with Virtual Director AI that auto-frames active speakers in real time, plus certified Microsoft IntelliFrame multi-stream and Intelligent Speaker (face/voice recognition) support for Teams intelligent recap. [Jabra (GN Audio) proprietary AI + Microsoft Teams IntelliFrame/Intelligent Speaker]

Jabra ClearVoice AI-driven voice isolation in the boomless Evolve3 headset series, using deep neural network (DNN) deep-learning trained on more than 60 million real-world sentences to separate the user's speech from background noise. [Jabra (GN Audio) ClearVoice / DNN]

SteelSeries GG Sonar audio software with AI-powered noise cancellation (ClearCast) that isolates the gamer's/streamer's voice and suppresses background noise for gaming and live streaming. [SteelSeries (GN)]

Jabra Enhance Select direct-to-consumer / OTC hearing aids with SoundScape AI-powered noise reduction and an app enabling self-fitting, remote adjustments and virtual access to an audiology team. [Jabra Enhance (GN)]

Jabra Enhance Plus miniature true-wireless earbuds delivering AI-based hearing enhancement (clearer conversations in noise) for people with mild-to-moderate hearing loss, blending hearing help with music and calls. [Jabra (GN)]

Jabra Engage AI / Engage AI Complete for contact centers: real-time tone-of-voice and sentiment analysis on both agent and caller, live speech-to-text transcription, generative-AI call summaries and agent coaching/guidance. [Jabra (GN Audio) with audEERING (voice emotion AI)]

ReSound Smart 3D / ReSound Assist remote-care platform: cloud/ML-assisted remote fine-tuning where users send requests from the app and clinicians push adjusted hearing-aid settings, plus Live Assistance video appointments, reducing in-clinic visits. [GN Hearing (ReSound)]

Internal enterprise use of Artificial Intelligence and machine learning across product innovation and business management, cited by GN as its combined AI capability applied in various areas of the business.
